description: Defines data structures and interfaces related to the Compact Font Format (CFF) used in font rendering, including index tables, font dictionaries, encoding, charset, and subfont structures.

classes.name: CFF_IndexRec
classes.description: Models a CFF Index table with stream, offset, count, and data pointers.

classes.name: CFF_EncodingRec
classes.description: Represents character encoding with format, offset, and character ID/code mappings.

classes.name: CFF_CharsetRec
classes.description: Defines character set with format, offset, and mappings for CID fonts.

classes.name: CFF_FontRecDictRec
classes.description: Contains font dictionary entries such as version, name, font metrics, and CID info.

classes.name: CFF_PrivateRec
classes.description: Holds private font data like blue values, stem widths, and other font hints.

classes.name: CFF_FDSelectRec
classes.description: Manages font dictionary selection for CID fonts with format and cache.

classes.name: CFF_SubFontRec
classes.description: Encapsulates a subfont with font and private dictionaries, and local subroutines.

classes.name: CFF_FontRec
classes.description: Main font structure including streams, encoding, charset, subfonts, and services.
